comments.author: AntinomyZeus
comments.body_html:
I’m sorry, but I can’t open Google from China, so I’m unable to submit the form.

It’s pretty clear that the M03 quest is asking for ammunition that can’t be crafted at this stage (although maybe they can be found in-raid?):

670f21e143b5fb2f15e44585 — .366 TKM FMJ Match Grade c479934981f716a4aa746106 — 7.62×39mm FMJ Match Grade 4012db58df2b5c63e64cc79f — 7.62×25mm TT Controlled-R (Refined) These rounds are unobtainable at the point where this quest takes place, since I don’t have access to the S-series quests yet. Not sure if that was intended.

That being said, the quest itself is perfectly fine — the mod is really polished and fun to play. I can still enjoy it by reading the required item names as part of the quest lore. Thank you for your great work!

comments.author: Forneus93
comments.body_html:
No problem at all — posting the report here is perfectly fine. Thank you for including the item IDs; that makes it much easier to track down.

You are correct: those three ammunition types should not be required for M03 before the corresponding S-series quests have been unlocked. That is an oversight in the quest requirements and not the intended progression. Even if some of them could theoretically be found in raid, completing a main quest should not depend on an extremely unlikely random spawn.

I’ll work on a hotfix later today. If you don’t want to wait, I would recommend to use the task skipper mod in the meantime. https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/1343/skipper

Thank you for catching this, and also for the kind words! Reports like this are extremely helpful during the alpha.
